title: Ankhorage Documentation Rules
summary: Provides documentation policy for Ankhorage source comments and generated documentation.
purpose: Keep documentation requirements in a reusable rule provider instead of duplicating them in generators and repositories.
responsibilities: Define rules for supported source documentation metadata.
Evaluate documentation facts through the generic Rules engine.
Provide consistent findings for source and generated documentation policy.
boundaries: Does not generate README files or interactive documentation.
Does not parse arbitrary source languages on behalf of documentation generators.
Does not own generic rule evaluation.
audience: Maintainers applying consistent Ankhorage documentation policy.
useCases: Validate source documentation metadata against the supported policy.
Evaluate documentation facts and receive actionable rule findings.
Share one documentation policy between validation and generation tooling.

invariants: The package defines policy but does not generate documentation artifacts.
Generic rule evaluation remains owned by @ankhorage/rules.
Documentation findings derive from explicit supplied facts.
